legal.t1p: By accessing or using Equal, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the application.
legal.t2p: You must be at least 18 years old to use Equal. By using the service, you represent that you meet this requirement.
legal.t3p: Equal uses Pi Network for authentication. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your Pi account. We do not store passwords or email addresses.
legal.t4p: You agree not to: harass other users, post offensive content, create fake profiles, solicit money, or use the app for commercial purposes without authorization.
legal.t5p: You retain ownership of content you post. By posting, you grant Equal a license to display your content to other users. We may remove content that violates these terms.
legal.t6p: All payments on Equal are processed through Pi Network. Equal does not handle fiat currency. Refunds are handled according to Pi Network policies.
legal.t7p: We may suspend or terminate your account for violations of these terms. You may delete your account at any time through the Settings page.
legal.t8p: Equal is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. We are not responsible for user interactions or outcomes from using the service.
legal.p1p: Equal collects only the minimum information necessary to provide our dating service:
legal.p1i1: Pi Network username and UID (via Pi authentication)
legal.p1i2: Profile information you voluntarily provide (bio, photos, interests, city)
legal.p2p: Equal is committed to privacy-first design. We do NOT collect:
legal.p2i4: Payment information (all payments go through Pi Network)
legal.p3p: Your information is used solely to:
legal.p3i2: Show your profile to potential matches
legal.p4p: All data is stored securely using industry-standard encryption. We use PostgreSQL with SSL connections and never store passwords or payment details. Messages are encrypted in transit and at rest.
legal.p5p: You can delete your account and all associated data at any time through the Settings page. This action is irreversible and removes all your profile information, photos, messages, and matches from our servers.
legal.p6p: For privacy-related questions, contact us through the Pi Network community channels or the Report feature in the app.
